definition: A global node is one KGX TSV row. A source-context entry is one object within that row's source_contexts JSON list. The original count3745 measured global nodes whose complete context lists were checked, not the number of context entries.
corrected_wording: All 7,022 prior source-context entries across 3,745 global nodes are preserved. The new pathway adds 66 source-context entries, yielding 7,088 entries across 3,775 global nodes.
effect: Clarifies reporting units only. Independent actual context-set preservation and record/graph/KGX conclusions remain unchanged; saved canonical reporting requires an append-only successor.
scope: Independent direct baseline/current CSV and full context-object comparison; no product, authority, record, review or Git writes.
